titulo: The Babysitting Job Had One Rule: Don't Fall Asleep 👁️ #Shorts
titulo_pt: O trabalho de babá tinha uma regra: não durma
resumo_pt: Uma babá recebe uma regra da mãe: ficar acordada a noite toda. Às três da manhã El Cucuy sai do armário, passa pelo menino dormindo e vai até ela; ela finge dormir e ele vai embora. De manhã a mãe fica pálida ao vê-la. Na geladeira há fotos de uma babá por ano, nenhuma voltou: a regra não era para proteger o menino, era para alimentar El Cucuy, que leva quem está acordado.
descricao:
El Cucuy takes the ones who stay awake. The parents knew that.

Would you have taken this babysitting job?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.
personagens: the narrator is a sixteen-year-old babysitter with a dark brown ponytail, a gray hoodie and jeans; Mateo is a small boy of six with curly black hair and dinosaur pajamas; the mom is a thin woman in her forties with short black hair and a beige coat; El Cucuy is a tall, thin shadowy creature with matted black hair all over its body, long arms, branch-like fingers and two glowing red eyes

scenes.text: The mom had one rule: stay awake all night. No matter what.
scenes.pt: A mãe tinha uma regra: ficar acordada a noite toda. Não importa o quê.
scenes.visual: the mom at the front door in her beige coat, pointing a finger at the babysitter, serious face

scenes.text: At three a.m., red eyes opened inside the closet.
scenes.pt: Às três da manhã, olhos vermelhos se abriram dentro do armário.
scenes.visual: El Cucuy's two glowing red eyes inside a dark half-open bedroom closet

scenes.text: Long hairy arms. Fingers like branches.
scenes.pt: Braços longos e peludos. Dedos como galhos.
scenes.visual: El Cucuy crawling out of the closet, long hairy arms and branch-like fingers reaching onto the floor

scenes.text: Mateo had warned me. El Cucuy lives there.
scenes.pt: O Mateo tinha me avisado. O Cucuy mora ali.
scenes.visual: Mateo asleep in bed in dinosaur pajamas, a night light glowing, the closet dark behind him

scenes.text: It walked right past his bed.
scenes.pt: Ele passou direto pela cama do menino.
scenes.visual: El Cucuy stepping past sleeping Mateo's bed without looking at him
El Cucuy looming toward the babysitter sitting in an armchair by the door

scenes.text: I shut my eyes and pretended to sleep.
scenes.pt: Fechei os olhos e fingi que estava dormindo.
scenes.visual: the babysitter alone in the armchair with her eyes squeezed shut, terrified

scenes.text: I felt its breath on my face.
scenes.pt: Senti o bafo dele no meu rosto.
scenes.visual: El Cucuy's face inches from the babysitter's, red eyes, her eyes shut

scenes.text: I kept my eyes shut until sunrise.
scenes.pt: Fiquei de olhos fechados até o sol nascer.
scenes.visual: sunrise light through the bedroom window, the babysitter still in the armchair, eyes shut

scenes.text: The parents came home at seven.
scenes.pt: Os pais chegaram em casa às sete.
scenes.visual: the mom opening the front door in the morning

scenes.text: The mom went pale when she saw me.
scenes.pt: A mãe ficou pálida quando me viu.
scenes.visual: the mom frozen in the doorway, pale and shocked, staring at the babysitter

scenes.text: On the fridge were photos of other babysitters.
scenes.pt: Na geladeira tinha fotos de outras babás.
scenes.visual: a fridge covered in photos of different teenage babysitters, the babysitter staring at it

scenes.text: One for every year. None of them came back.
scenes.pt: Uma para cada ano. Nenhuma delas voltou.
scenes.visual: close up of the fridge photos, each one labeled with only a year

scenes.text: The rule was never to protect Mateo.
scenes.pt: A regra nunca foi para proteger o Mateo.
scenes.visual: the mom hugging Mateo in the kitchen, looking at the babysitter with guilt

scenes.text: It was to feed El Cucuy.
scenes.visual: the dark closet door in daylight, slightly open, red eyes faintly visible inside
